usedFor: Todoist is where projects start and Runrun.it tracks them with time, so “Project Created” can feed “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “Project Created” in Todoist, then “Create Project” in Runrun.it
bestTemplate.why: A new project in Todoist gets its counterpart in Runrun.it without retyping.

watchOut: “Project Created” in Todoist is polling, so “Create Project” in Runrun.it runs after a scheduled check.
